_comment: Provenance for the Chromium notice shipped in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
Electron bundles Chromium, whose BSD-3-Clause requires the copyright notice,
the conditions and the disclaimer to be reproduced in binary redistributions.
The full third-party credits (LICENSES.chromium.html) are 19 MB, so this build
ships Chromium's own notice verbatim and links the full set upstream.
Kept verbatim, comment markers and all: Chromium publishes its LICENSE as a
C++ header block, and 'reproduce' argues against reformatting a legal notice.
To refresh after an Electron upgrade:
then update electron/chromium/fetched/sha256 here. npm run audit fails until the
electron version recorded here matches the installed one.
verified: byte-identical to the 150.0.7871.212 notice it replaced

fullCredits.file: LICENSES.chromium.html (19 MB, in the Electron distribution)
